reason: Software contracts cover break-fix issues and software bugs. New installations, new setups, terminal relocations, menu creation, printer-routing changes, and extensive configuration changes are outside normal software contract coverage.
conditions: The matched request is materially involved in the current service
The work involves a new installation, new setup, relocation, or configuration change
The work is not break-fix troubleshooting or correction of an existing software bug

reason: Consumable items may be outside normal contract coverage and may change an otherwise free service to billable.
conditions: The matched item is materially involved in the current service
The item was supplied, replaced, repaired, or serviced
The item is confirmed to be outside the applicable contract coverage

reason: Print heads are treated as possible consumables only for USA meat/deli scale service.
conditions: The print head is for a meat or deli scale
The print head is materially involved in the current service
The print head is confirmed to be outside the applicable contract coverage

reason: Canadian payment-related service requires billing review.
conditions: The payment device or payment processing issue is materially involved in the current service

reason: Explicit billing language may indicate separately billable work and requires evaluation before overriding contract coverage.
conditions: The phrase refers to the current work order rather than historical or reference information
The billing language is materially related to the current service or charge

reason: Physical, accidental, liquid, fire, or environmental damage may be outside normal contract coverage.
conditions: The phrase describes the current equipment condition or cause of failure

reason: Theft or tampering-related damage may not be covered by normal service contracts.
conditions: The theft or tampering condition is materially related to the current service request

reason: Security, malware, and PCI-related services may fall outside standard hardware or software support coverage.
conditions: The security, malware, or compliance issue is materially involved in the current service

reason: Installation and setup work may represent project or change work outside normal break/fix service.
conditions: Installation, setup, or reinstallation is part of the actual work performed or requested
The phrase does not merely describe routine troubleshooting

reason: Configuration, programming, and scripting may represent additional work outside normal contract service.
conditions: Configuration, programming, or scripting is actual requested or performed work
The phrase is not merely part of diagnostic troubleshooting

reason: Relocation and transfer work may be separately billable rather than normal break/fix support.
conditions: Equipment, systems, or services are actually being moved, relocated, or transferred

reason: Customer-requested additions and changes may fall outside existing contract coverage.
conditions: The customer requested new, additional, or changed functionality or equipment
The phrase represents additional work rather than repair of an existing covered item

reason: Removal, replacement, and supplied-item terminology is common in normal repair work and requires context before being treated as potentially billable.
conditions: The activity represents additional, non-standard, or customer-requested work
Normal replacement of a failed contract-covered component does not activate this rule

reason: Upgrade work may represent enhancement rather than repair and may be outside normal contract coverage.
conditions: The current work includes upgrading equipment, software, configuration, or functionality

reason: Data restoration, import/export, and corruption-related work may require separate billing evaluation.
conditions: The restore, data operation, or corruption issue is materially involved in the current service

reason: Network and connectivity issues may involve infrastructure outside normal supported equipment coverage.
conditions: The network, ISP, or IP issue is a material cause of the service request
Diagnostic use of ping or IP information alone does not activate the rule

reason: External power failures or outages may represent conditions outside normal contract coverage.
conditions: The external power event caused or materially contributed to the current service request

reason: Training and advisory services may not be included in normal break/fix service coverage.
conditions: The primary work is user training, instruction, consultation, or operational assistance

reason: Service involving laptops, mobile devices, PDAs, or tablets may require confirmation that the device is within contract scope.
conditions: The referenced device is materially involved in the current service

reason: Menu and department changes may represent customer-requested configuration work outside standard break/fix coverage.
conditions: The current work involves creating, modifying, moving, or configuring a department or menu

reason: These are weak billing indicators and require surrounding context before they can affect the billing decision.
conditions: The phrase is materially related to potentially out-of-scope work
The phrase alone is not sufficient to trigger a billing decision
